# Anonymous Video Chat Blocklist — source list
#
# Omegle-style services that pair users with random strangers over video.
#
# One domain per line. Lowercase, alphabetical order.
# Inline notes are allowed:   example.tv  # Omegle clone, see #12
#
# Blocklists are built from this file into dist/. Do not edit dist/ by hand.
# Run `python3 scripts/build.py --fix` to sort and de-duplicate before committing.
